title: docs: correct harness model examples
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replace stale model aliases in setup examples with canonical catalog IDs.
- Correct the documented OpenCode, OpenClaw, Pi and DeepSeek defaults.
- Validate the IDs against the live catalog; all 111 CLI tests and the build pass.

Follow-up to #14666.

gist.headline: Names, Now Canonical
gist.blurb: The harness setup examples got their labels straightened out. OpenCode, OpenClaw, Pi, and DeepSeek now point at the models that actually live in the catalog.
gist.summary: Updated CODING_HARNESSES.md and Polli CLI documentation to replace stale model aliases with canonical live-catalog IDs, including the documented defaults for OpenCode, OpenClaw, Pi, and DeepSeek.
gist.impact: Developers following the harness and Polli CLI setup guides can now copy the documented model IDs and defaults directly into working configurations.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy documentation garden where old handwritten model-name tags have been replaced with neat canonical catalog labels. Polli acts as a careful librarian-gardener, checking a glowing terminal catalog while code-plants for OpenCode, OpenClaw, Pi, and DeepSeek grow from labeled pots.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with black antennae, oval eyes, pink rectangular cheek blush, light blue rounded wings, and a tiny librarian hat, carefully replacing old labels on four code-plant pots with clean canonical model IDs while a retro terminal glows lime green (#ecf874) with a checked catalog list. Small flowers and vines surround the OpenCode, OpenClaw, Pi, and DeepSeek pots; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) pixel-font text reading “CATALOG CHECKED”, nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
